ai_review.summary: A hot early‑fall show highlighted by a superb Dark Star → Morning Dew splice and overall strong performance, with generally good sound aside from occasional voice bleed.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the energy of this first hot fall concert, calling it one of the best shows ever and praising the seamless splice that extends Morning Dew after Dark Star. The recording is mostly praised as a nice copy, though one listener notes an audible voice bleed before “Let Me Sing Your Blues Away,” indicating a minor tape‑artifact issue.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews highlight an excellent performance and solid recording, while one 2‑star review points out a noticeable audio flaw; overall rating reflects strong show quality with generally good but not flawless sound.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Splice of Dark Star into Morning Dew praised for improving flow; one reviewer mentions hearing a voice bleed before “Let Me Sing Your Blues Away,” indicating a minor tape artifact.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong early‑fall energy with smooth transitions, especially the extended Dark Star → Morning Dew sequence.
